chapter: Acid-Base Balance, Renal Hormones and Micturition Reflex

questions.question: In a patient with metabolic acidosis, which of the following changes are seen?

suspectLines.text: K+ secretion into the renal tubules is decreased when H+ secretion is increased (intracellular buffering of H+). Thus in metabolic acidosis, there is decreased K+ excretion.
